messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Segmentation information
parts:
On Tue, Jul 8, 2008 at 5:07 PM, lixia <dia...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> We used the GLAD model to do segmentation. After that, we tried to see
> the output file containing for example the start and end location,
> mean CN, ect for each segment. I searched from internet, but could not
> find the corresponding commands. Is there some way I can reach those
> information?

This information can be found in the reports/<data set name>/<data set
tags>/<chip type>/glad/regions.xls file, which is a tab-delimited text
file. It is in the same directory as all your *.png image files.
You can also find a link to this file in the lower-left corner of the
ChromsomeExplorer page in your browser.

You can also get the same regions as data frames, by doing:

data <- getRegions(glad, arrays=1:2, chromosomes=17:19)

This will fit the segmentation method automatically, if not already
done. The same thing also work for CbsModel.

Hope this helps

Henrik
